body:
I managed to narrow the issue down a little and it seems that history currently works only by accident.

When moving forward and backward through history, the history is always locked at this location:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63e14e13f972671a43abcf019962129e5cca7d01/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp#L3871-L3873

Usually it is unlocked immediately after that in `_save_previous_state` method:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63e14e13f972671a43abcf019962129e5cca7d01/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp#L676-L681

Sometimes that method is not called and the history remains locked. In that case some actions that should normally update the history are ignored in `_go_to_tab` method so some files may be missing from the history so going back in history will take you to some unexpected location.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63e14e13f972671a43abcf019962129e5cca7d01/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp#L731-L734

As far as I can tell, the `_save_previous_state` method is only called as a signal handler when caret moves and only when it moves by more than 10 lines:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63e14e13f972671a43abcf019962129e5cca7d01/editor/script/script_text_editor.cpp#L1262-L1275

So maybe sometimes when navigating through history the caret is moved and the signal emitted and sometimes not.

This seems wonky. I would like to fix it but I am not sure how. I guess that there should be a reliable way to unlock the history once the lock is no longer needed but how?
